nominal digest_bytes = $'Vec<u8>'

c6 1/1
inl percent (s : string) : string =
    $'Rc::<str>::from(!s​.bytes().map(|b| if b​.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"-._~".contains(&b) { (b as char).to_string() } else { format\!("%{:02X}", b) }).collect::<String>())'

c7 1/1
inl hmac_sha1 (key : string) (text : string) : digest_bytes =
    $'{ let mut m = <hmac::Hmac<sha1::Sha1> as hmac::KeyInit>::new_from_slice(!key​.as_bytes()).unwrap(); hmac::Mac::update(&mut m, !text​.as_bytes()); hmac::Mac::finalize(m).into_bytes().to_vec() }'

c8 1/1
inl base64_of (b : digest_bytes) : string =
    $'Rc::<str>::from(base64::Engine::encode(&base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, &!b))'

c9 1/1
inl sha1_hex (text : string) : string =
    $'Rc::<str>::from(<sha1::Sha1 as sha1::Digest>::digest(!text​.as_bytes()).iter().map(|b| format\!("{:02x}", b)).collect::<String>())'

c10 1/1
inl clock_seed () : string =
    $'Rc::<str>::from(format\!("{}-{}", std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_nanos(), std::process::id()))'

c11 1/1
inl unix_seconds () : string =
    $'Rc::<str>::from(std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs().to_string())'

c12 1/1
inl fresh_nonce () : string = sha1_hex (clock_seed ())

c13 1/1
inl before ((ka, va) : pair) ((kb, vb) : pair) : bool =
    if ka <> kb then comp ka kb |> lt_is else comp va vb |> lt_is

c14 1/1
let rec insert_sorted (x : pair) (l : list pair) : list pair =
    match l with
    | Cons (y, ys) when before y x => Cons (y, insert_sorted x ys)
    | _ => Cons (x, l)

c15 1/1
inl sorted_pairs (l : list pair) : list pair = listm​.fold (fun acc x => insert_sorted x acc) Nil l

c16 1/1
inl param_string (params : list pair) : string =
    params |> each (fun (k, v) => percent k, percent v) |> sorted_pairs
    |> each (fun (k, v) => k ++# "=" ++# v) |> sm'.concat_list "&"

c17 1/1
inl base_string (method : string) (url : string) (params : list pair) : string =
    method ++# "&" ++# percent url ++# "&" ++# percent (param_string params)

c18 1/1
inl signing_key (o : oauth1) : string = percent o​.consumer_secret ++# "&" ++# percent o​.token_secret

c19 1/1
inl consumer_params (o : oauth1) (nonce : string) : list pair =
    [("oauth_consumer_key", o​.consumer_key); ("oauth_nonce", nonce); ("oauth_signature_method", "HMAC-SHA1")]

c20 1/1
inl token_params (o : oauth1) (stamp : string) : list pair = [("oauth_timestamp", stamp); ("oauth_token", o​.token); ("oauth_version", "1.0")]

c21 1/1
inl oauth_params (o : oauth1) (nonce : string) (stamp : string) : list pair =
    listm​.append (consumer_params o nonce) (token_params o stamp)

c22 1/1
inl signature (o : oauth1) (method : string) (url : string) (params : list pair) : string =
    base_string method url params |> hmac_sha1 (signing_key o) |> base64_of

c23 1/1
inl quoted ((k, v) : pair) : string = percent k ++# "=\"" ++# percent v ++# "\""

c24 1/1
inl signed_params (o : oauth1) (method : string) (url : string) (params : list pair) : list pair =
    listm​.append params [("oauth_signature", signature o method url params)]

c25 1/1
let oauth_header (o : oauth1) (method : string) (url : string) (nonce : string) (stamp : string) : string =
    inl params = oauth_params o nonce stamp
    "OAuth " ++# (signed_params o method url params |> each quoted |> sm'.concat_list ", ")
